exposure: environmental education (EE) component of pre-school teacher training programs
outcome: gap between EE and pre-service teacher training
disparity in program designer's EE views
cohort: The study examined the framework of pre-school teacher training programs at six universities in Vietnam and interviewed 18 students in their final year of undergraduate study.
finding: The study found a clear gap between environmental education (EE) and the training of pre-service teachers, along with a disparity in program designers' EE views reflecting the priority given to environmentally-related courses.
cross-section timing: Current (at the time of the study) pre-school teacher training programs and final-year undergraduate students.
